title: Boston Scientific Discloses Cyberattack Data Breach
excerpt: Medical technology firm Boston Scientific has begun notifying individuals impacted by a recent cyberattack that exposed personal and medical information.
body_html:
Medical technology company Boston Scientific has started issuing notification letters to individuals whose personal and medical data was compromised in a cyberattack.

The company is currently reaching out to affected parties to inform them about the security incident and the exposure of their sensitive information.
